description: Four minimal representative teaching missions; each condition must use the same fixed Swedish-English sentence source in verb-library/<level>.json. These are content seeds rather than existing completed mission implementations.

missions.title: Talking about your work
missions.learnerGoal: Describe where you work and explain where someone worked before.

missions.title: Explaining a situation
missions.learnerGoal: Understand and explain situations, including a reason for being late.

missions.title: Making a proposal
missions.learnerGoal: Understand professional suggestions and describe a proposed change.

missions.title: Examining possible influences
missions.learnerGoal: Discuss evidence, competing explanations and effects of decisions.

provenance: Derived as standardized mission seeds from pre-existing recovered verb library; mission metadata formulated during October 2026 experiment preparation. Swedish examples are unchanged and referenced from the verb library.
status: Prepared shared input; functional lesson code and generated exercise questions are not yet built.
acceptanceNote: Each experimental implementation should provide at least one playable Swedish example, English assistance, a comprehension check, a verb-form exercise, feedback and persisted per-user progress for each of four levels.
